n1.text: Moving lineup: runs right to left. Hover, or press and hold, stops it. Tap a poster to select it and its details appear below. A Pause button is always visible.

n2.text: Pill bar: sits right above the headline. Tap the search icon and the pill opens into a search field with an example query.

n3.text: Posh as the backbone: white page, black type, one huge tight headline, terracotta buttons. Poster art and events are placeholders.

t1.text: Landing page: mobile first, then desktop

t2.text: Rest of the page, in scroll order (mobile)

n4.text: All numbers, organizer names and activity in these sections are samples. Real data replaces them; the count-up and the live feed stay.

n5.text: Pill menu: hover (desktop) or tap the menu button (mobile) opens a panel under the pill and blurs the page behind it. Nothing reloads. Phones that cannot blur get a plain frosted tint instead.

n6.text: Live pulse: the conversation loops with typing dots, and the countdown ticks in real time. In the live product the messages show real traffic, real stock and the next real on-sale.

n7.text: Organizer showcase: rotates by itself. Tap a name to stop it, or use the pause button.
